title: WCAG color constrast fails on toolbar direction icon

latest.text: Proposed solution. https://github.com/mgifford/drupal-core-lab/blob/main/reports/issues/327... It is basically switching #bebebe for #787878 Greater context for those who want it: https://github.com/mgifford/drupal-core-lab/tree/main/report
